findings.title: The cluster found no node for the run's pod before the Job's deadline, so it never started.
evidence: Pod/ahoy-proj-118-planning-002-4c1d-x7k2p FailedScheduling (×14): 0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu.
Pod/ahoy-proj-118-planning-002-4c1d-x7k2p NotTriggerScaleUp: pod didn't trigger scale-up: 1 max node group size reached
job: DeadlineExceeded: Job was active longer than specified deadline
findings.action: Ask the platform team for capacity (the node pool's maximum size or the autoscaler), or lower the worker's requests; then resume the story. The run had not started, so it spent nothing.
